name: howto
title: Set up an e-reader without the extras
sub: Do these in the first 30 days, while you can still return it
footer: From Amazon's and Kobo's help pages and Prof H Lab, read Nov 13, 2026. Menu names change with updates.

items.head: Check the ads
items.body: Base Kindle and Paperwhite show lockscreen ads. Amazon's pop-up shows the removal price before you pay.

items.head: Pick your library route
items.body: Kobo has Libby built in. Kindle sends loans from the Libby app on a phone.

items.head: Use Reading so far
items.body: Ask this Book and Recaps cannot be turned off; choosing Reading so far limits spoilers.

items.head: Clear the history
items.body: Clear History in the Ask this Book panel; Amazon says it clears itself after 90 days idle.

items.head: Test the screen
items.body: Open dark mode and look at the edges for glow. Exchange a bad unit inside the window.

items.head: Read update notes
items.body: Owners report updates that drained batteries or hid books. Update on Wi-Fi with a full charge.
